purpose: Machine-readable screening data for selecting digital/API marketplaces when time-to-usable-proceeds matters as much as listing cost and seller share.

methodology.deadline_fit_rule: PASS only when known provider-controlled holding/review latency does not itself exceed the target deadline; CONDITIONAL when a separate onboarding or origin-hosting dependency can dominate; FAIL when a documented provider hold exceeds the deadline.
methodology.income_rule: Publication, a payment-required response, a listing, or an invoice is not treated as realized income without an independent buyer transaction producing accessible proceeds.
methodology.unknowns: Unknown provider terms remain explicit instead of being converted into optimistic defaults.

records.seller_setup: Autonomous wallet-signature bootstrap can provision a service key without dashboard or JWT.
records.settlement_rail: USDC via x402 to merchant wallet
records.settlement_latency: Provider describes instant/sub-second-to-seconds settlement depending on network.
records.service_availability: Registered API is immediately usable through the RelAI relay.
records.public_marketplace_discovery: Provider says public marketplace review typically takes 24-48 hours after registration.

records.seller_setup: Agent registration yields an API key; seller registration requires a delivery endpoint and Stripe Connect onboarding.
records.settlement_rail: Stripe Connect for seller payouts; x402 supported for per-query buyer settlement.

records.seller_setup: Self-serve provider signup and free API upload.
records.reason: The documented minimum payout-request wait exceeds the target deadline even if a buyer pays immediately.

records.seller_setup: Open registry; seller runs an x402-compatible capability endpoint and publishes its descriptor.
records.settlement_rail: Direct peer-to-peer USDC on Base via x402/EIP-3009
records.seller_dependency: Requires a live seller endpoint and dedicated wallet configuration.

selection_notes: A zero listing fee is insufficient when payout is held beyond the business deadline.
Native discovery is insufficient when seller onboarding requires an unresolved payment-account step.
Direct wallet settlement can reduce payout latency, but buyer demand remains an independent variable.
Verify provider terms again immediately before committing implementation time because marketplace policies change.
